system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
the agent automatically loads `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md` from the
project root or any ancestor directory, injecting their contents into the
system prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt modes switchable at runtime; ARCHITECTURE.md and memory also appended. Quote spans line breaks in README.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Allow read tools. Ask for writes, edits, bash, and everything else. Config rules apply.
env_context_strategy.note: Tools read/grep/find_files/list_dir (src/agent/tools). ARCHITECTURE.md/AGENTS.md injection is project-authored context, not a file-tree summary; /add opt-in.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: auto-compaction to stay within context windows
context_compaction.note: Also /compress command; src/extras/truncate.rs exists suggesting tool_output_pruning but content not in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Runner streams AgentEvent (Token, Reasoning, ToolCall, ToolResult, Done)

tool_call_format.note: Parser code not in evidence; inferred from rig tool abstraction.

tool_count.note: Tool files: bash, edit, find_files, grep, list_dir, read, todo, write, plus task tool (subagents default) and Exa web tools; exact default list not shown.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Use SEARCH/REPLACE with fuzzy matching for edits (default).
edit_primitive.note: write tool gives whole-file; hashedit (CRC-32 tag-based) alternative, closest to line_range_edit, not coded.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: connect MCP servers for extended tooling (exposed as an optional compile-time feature)
tool_schema_source.note: Native tool schema source not visible in evidence; mcp is in default build.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Default: loop, git-worktree, mcp, subagents, archmd, status-signals, multithread
protocol_standardization.note: other = ACP (Agent Client/Communication Protocol) server, gated feature.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent repeatedly reads the task, picks an item from the plan, works on it, runs tests, updates the plan, and loops until the task is complete or the iteration limit is reached.
loop_primitives.note: react default; loop (Ralph) with --loop-run validation is opt-in; prompt chaining pipeline also available.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Each iteration includes the original task, the evolving `LOOP_PLAN.md`
planning_granularity.note: Todo-list tools toggleable; LOOP_PLAN.md in loop mode.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: **Subagents**: Parallel and fast, used for exploring the codebase
multi_agent_topology.note: subagents feature default-on via task tool.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
when using the `task` tool, subagents
understand the architecture without querying the main agent

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Ask for external paths and unrecognized commands.
human_in_loop.note: Default mode standard; five modes selectable. Prompt chaining offers Y/N/B between phases.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: plain-Markdown memory across sessions: a global MEMORY.md plus per-project daily logs, scratchpad, and notes, injected into the system prompt each session
long_term_memory.note: memory feature gated, not default build; AGENTS.md/ARCHITECTURE.md also persist.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Use `-c` to
resume the most recent session

self_verification.evidence_quote: `--loop-run <cmd>` | Validation command to run after each iteration
self_verification.note: Opt-in: loop validation; advisor second model (gated) closest to llm_judge. /review is self_critique on demand.

retry_policy.note: Loop mode opt-in iterates; src/retry.rs likely transport retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: `/wt-exit` | Return to the main repo without merging
rollback.note: Worktrees opt-in; /undo and /rewind revert conversation only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
identical tool calls repeated 3+ times trigger a
warning prompt (or denial depending on your config)
termination_condition.note: max_steps via --loop-max in loop mode; model ends turn by default.

cost_controls.note: Subagent model switch exists; pricing.rs tracks cost; no budget evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
which runs every bash command inside an isolated environment to protect your
system
execution_isolation.note: Default runs on host; --sandbox bubblewrap/zerobox opt-in.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Allow path tools (read/write/edit/list_dir) within CWD and subdirectories.
filesystem_access.note: Scoping by permission prompt; bash unrestricted host access.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Safe bash commands (ls, cat, git log, cargo check) auto-allowed. Ask for external paths and unrecognized commands. Config rules apply and override mode defaults.
permission_model.note: Rule-based mode plus glob patterns plus per-call prompt.

tracing.evidence_quote: or to JSONL when the file ends in `.jsonl`

guardrails.evidence_quote: observe or gate tool calls, prompts, and session lifecycle events via external commands
guardrails.note: Hooks gated; permission system default action policy.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Minimal coding agent written in Rust

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, plus custom providers

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Lightweight coding agent written in Rust, optimized for memory footprint and performance
